title: Multi-region resiliency and DR runbook
scenario: The CIO staff wants the new help desk to meet a 15-minute voice RTO with an AWS-supported multi-region pattern, tested twice a year. You get the requirements, volumes, telephony inventory (two DIDs not yet ported), dependencies (Lambdas, Lex, DynamoDB, S3/KMS, ServiceNow allow list) and the incident history.
task: Design the us-east-1 / us-west-2 architecture with Connect Global Resiliency
Plan numbers, agents and identity, chat, and every regional dependency
Write a timed failover and failback runbook with triggers and verification
Plan drills, cost answer for the CFO, risks and gaps
acceptance: Graded by rubric only (grade.sh reports 0/0; the automated row does not apply)
ACGR mechanics correct: TDG numbers, distribution percentages, global sign-in, prerequisites
Every dependency has a secondary-region plan and a parity mechanism
Runbook fits the 15-minute RTO and includes verification and failback

practices.label: Week 1 Fri - Connect Global Resiliency and traffic distribution groups
Week 3 - numbers, porting and telephony resilience
Week 2 - SLA/SLO and DR design for the platform
